name: Itoman (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Itoman city emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Itoman, a city in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 December 1971.

features.role: Itoman city emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised swirl
